requested_quantity_or_analysis: Matched male-specific and female-specific MR for BMI and each FinnGen structural endpoint
availability_at_audit: Exposure side available for BMI; matched sex-specific FinnGen outcome summary statistics not available in the authorized local project environment
evidence_checked: GIANT male-only and female-only BMI files were downloaded and formatted; FinnGen sex-specific data documentation and the project directory were audited; the attempted green-library route required authenticated authorization
action_completed: Retained the male/female BMI exposure-preparation audit and documented the exact outcome fields and metadata required in Supplementary Tables S22-S24

permitted_interpretation: No sex-specific causal estimate is reported; the analysis is feasible after authorized matched outcome files are obtained

requested_quantity_or_analysis: Exact covariance between BMI and smoking-initiation SNP-association estimation errors
availability_at_audit: Not reported in the public OpenGWAS summary-association extracts and not identifiable from marginal beta and standard-error columns alone
evidence_checked: Cross-exposure union-SNP matrices, OpenGWAS metadata, and local MVMR scripts/outputs were audited
action_completed: Recalculated conditional F statistics over a prespecified constant correlation grid rho=-0.90 to 0.90 using the covariance term implied by each rho; archived assumptions and results in Supplementary Table S27
remaining_requirement: Individual-level data, joint GWAS score-statistic covariance, or consortium-provided per-SNP covariance generated from the same overlapping participants
permitted_interpretation: BMI conditional strength remained above 10 throughout the stress-test grid; smoking-initiation conditional strength remained below 10 throughout the grid
prohibited_interpretation: The stress test does not estimate the true covariance and cannot be described as an exact-covariance MVMR analysis

requested_quantity_or_analysis: Exact number of shared participants for each primary exposure-outcome pair and for BMI versus smoking-initiation GWAS
availability_at_audit: Not reported as a pairwise participant intersection by the public consortium/OpenGWAS metadata and not recoverable from summary association statistics
evidence_checked: Source-cohort metadata, the exposure-outcome pairing matrix, MRlap inputs/outputs, and the overlap-boundary scenarios were audited
action_completed: Maintained non-FinnGen exposure versus FinnGen outcome pairing, reported low expected rather than measured overlap, retained formal MRlap correction, and explicitly labeled Supplementary Table S18 as illustrative
remaining_requirement: Cohort-level participant identifiers or consortium-computed pairwise intersection counts for every contributing study
permitted_interpretation: The design reduces avoidable primary exposure-outcome overlap and MRlap provides correction-based sensitivity evidence

evidence_checked: Source files under runs_endpoint_hierarchy were checked for mr_keep and required beta/se columns and were hashed before rerunning
action_completed: Archived original and analysis-ready CSVs, recorded SHA-256 hashes, used fixed pair-specific seeds, preserved full R objects, warnings, run parameters, and sessionInfo, and reran the primary 500-simulation specification
